messages:
alex: Hey team — customer acme_inc reports SSO stopped ~20m after IdP cert rotation. Users see 'Signature verification failed' on login and we have Recipient mismatch logs referencing our ACS. Can someone take a look?

maya: On it. can you paste the exact error snippet from our logs and their ACS URL?

alex: Logs: `SAMLResponse validation error: signature does not match available signing keys` and `Recipient mismatch: expected https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/acs/` — Customer SP ACS configured as `https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/acs` (no trailing slash). Their IdP metadata URL: https://idp.acme-inc.com/metadata.xml

sam: quick theory — metadata rotation published a new key but ordering has old key first (and first KeyDescriptor has no `use` attribute). Our parser sometimes picks the first key when `use` is absent. if their active key is second, signature will fail. can you fetch the metadata and paste KeyDescriptor bits?

alex: fetched. relevant excerpt: 
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme-inc.com/">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor>
      <KeyInfo>...old-key...</KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo>...new-key...</KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

maya: yep that's the issue. our metadata cache kept the old ordering and because first KeyDescriptor lacks `use` we picked it. opsbot can you clear metadata cache for tenant acme_inc? @opsbot

opsbot: cleared metadata cache for tenant `acme_inc` (tenant id: t-12345). status: OK.

alex: re-tested immediately after cache clear — still failing with same signature error.

kai: two things to check: 1) recipient/audience normalization (trailing slash) and 2) multiple EntityID / AssertionAudience differences. the Recipient mismatch appears before signature check sometimes, and our code rejects if recipient doesn't match exactly. their SP uses no-trailing-slash while our SP canonicalizes with trailing slash. we should accept both on a per-tenant workaround.

maya: enabled temporary recipient_normalization for t-12345 (allow trailing slash/no-trailing-slash equivalence). please retry.

alex: one user login now succeeded, but admin user still fails intermittently. logs now show `AssertionAudienceMismatch` for one of the assertions. their metadata has two EntityID entries (https://idp.acme-inc.com/ and https://idp.acme-inc.com/alias) and some IdP flows seem to pick the alias as Audience.

sam: that explains intermittent. our SP checks Audience against configured IdP entityIDs list; if IdP sends alias we need to accept it only if it's present in metadata. it is present, but some assertions have Audience with trailing path or different fragment? ask customer to verify IdP assertion settings. Also long-term fix: prefer KeyDescriptor with `use="signing"` when present instead of first-key fallback. I'll open an internal ticket to change parser logic.

maya: for immediate mitigation, asked customer to: 1) reorder KeyDescriptor so the active signing key is first OR add `use="signing"` to the new key; 2) confirm SP ACS exactly matches our ACS (trailing slash) or keep normalization enabled temporarily; 3) rotate with overlap (publish new key then retire old after 48h). Also requested they send three failed SAML responses (base64) for us to inspect.

jen: adding eng-security and product-saml on this. @sam pls include proposed parser change and tests in the ticket. jenkins: tag and severity P2 for customer impact. I'll draft customer-facing guidance email.

alex: drafting email now with: metadata URL, suggested immediate steps, and request for 3 sample SAMLResponses. sending in 5. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

maya: follow-up notes for internal record: reproduction steps I used —
```bash
# fetch metadata and show KeyDescriptor order
curl -sS https://idp.acme-inc.com/metadata.xml | xmllint --format - | sed -n '/KeyDescriptor/,/KeyDescriptor/p'
# simulate SAMLResponse validation with our dev tool
./saml-debug --sp-acs https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/acs/ --idp-metadata metadata.xml --response sample_response.b64
```

sam: thanks. escalation ticket created: SSO-4821. next actions: eng to update parser, support to coordinate customer changes, ops to monitor t-12345 for 24h.

alex: confirmed customer got the email and will reorder keys + re-run rotation with overlap. closing loop once we see green.

maya: noted. closing thread here unless new failures reported.
